name: daisyUI
tagline: The most popular Tailwind CSS component library
description: A free, open-source plugin that adds component class names on top of Tailwind CSS — buttons, cards, modals, navbars and more, themeable through CSS variables and drop-in on any JS framework with no JS bundle of its own. Ships as a Tailwind plugin so every component stays pure CSS.

best.title: Components
best.note: The full component gallery, themeable via CSS variables.

best.title: Install
best.note: npm i -D daisyui@latest, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS.
